Explain in your own words what is meant by a *{{< var dim.dim >}}*?

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("RQ-dim")`

<!-- Opening answer: Reading-questions-1ly -->
::: {.callout-tip collapse=true `r devoirs:::answer_style()`}
## Answer
A {{< var dim.dim >}} refers to the specification of the "kind" or "type" of a quantity in terms of products, powers, or quotients of fundamental dimensions such as length, time, and mass.
